story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_100_10: I’m glad we talked to Leon!
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_200_10:
I think we’ll put up a good fight at the
Arceus Cup!
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_300_10: Are you sure you’ll be able to go all out?
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_600_10:
then let’s have a serious battle—right here,
right now.
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_800_10: Ahahaha! You noticed I was a little off, huh.
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_900_10: Heh. I’ve known you for a while.
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_1100_10: I was remembering something you told me.
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_1300_10:
You said having fun was my excuse for not
being able to beat my grandpa when he’s
serious.
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_1400_10:
Yeah... I remember saying something like
that.
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_1500_10:
I thought I was ready to battle seriously,
without holding back.
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_1600_10:
But maybe I’ve still been looking for an
excuse not to.
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_1800_10:
How about I help you remember how to be
serious, Hau?
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_1900_10: Let’s battle all-out at the Arceus Cup!
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_2000_10:
I’ll definitely awaken my arc suit. Silvally
and I will be the strongest sync pair ever!
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_2100_10: So give me your all, Hau!
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_2200_10: Especially if you wanna enjoy the battle.
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_2400_10:
I’ll awaken my arc suit with Raichu,
then WE’LL be the strongest sync pair.
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_2600_10: Heh. It won’t be that easy.
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_2800_10: What, you’re not gonna talk to them?
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_2900_10: Didn’t you come to give ’em a pep talk?
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_3200_10:
One’s your former mentor’s grandson,
and the other was Team Skull’s muscle.
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_3300_10: Isn’t it hard for you to pick a side?
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_3600_10:
They better see this through to the end,
or I’ll crush ’em myself!
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_3700_10: We’ve got enough slackers with us around!
story_arceus_11_03000/2401_1001_3800_10: Sheesh... Just say that next time.
